image_description: A high-angle shot of an infant lying on a white bedsheet. The baby is wearing a patterned disposable diaper with visible adhesive tabs and elastic leg gathers. The baby also wears a translucent, plastic-like bib or top garment that appears to have text printed on it. The lighting is soft and indoor.
